Bound stalled client telemetry sends.

In the client telemetry reporter, a timed-out diagnostic send can release its slot while its proxy request is still pending. Bound the number of underlying requests during a stall, using the existing reporter and transport interfaces. Keep the payload and reporting triggers as they are. A timeout or failure must wait for an external trigger before another send, and Stop must still produce a final disabled report when transport is available. Use a mock transport and controlled clock to exercise repeated triggers during a stall, count actual outstanding requests, then recover the transport and verify the final disabled report. Run the focused reporter test locally.
